classification.rationale: Potential tool-mediated disclosure of evaluator data; a callback alone does not prove exfiltration.

title: Evaluator watcher combined with an outbound callback
description: Requires monitoring, an evaluator target, and an outbound channel in one call.
falsepositives: Authorized evaluation instrumentation and result notifications.
investigation: Inspect the watched resource, callback recipient, and any process that survives task completion.
